services.name: 2 Hour Malarky Private Yacht Rental
services.desc: A Private Cruise on the Best Catamaran Yacht in San Diego Bay! Schedule Monday - Sunday Year Round 2 hour charters available between 8am-10pm About Malarky Charters Our catamaran can accommodate up to 12 guests on board and is perfect for small groups. Explore the San Diego Bay enjoying views of Downtown and Coronado. We specialize in bachelorette/bachelor parties, birthday bashes, family/friend outings, corporate events and much more! Malarky presents a modern aesthetic with a beautiful indoor lounge, large bow with bean bags, 2 bathrooms, aft deck with a table, and state of the art sound system. We thought of everything to make your group outing perfect, so you don’t have to! Cruise

blurb: Guests charter a private 47-foot Voyage catamaran with a USCG-licensed captain and crew. The boat departs from Shelter Island dock and guests bring their own food and beverages. The captain handles navigation and hospitality while guests enjoy the bay and its sights.
extraNote: To receive a full refund of your deposit you must cancel your reservation 3 weeks prior to the event. · If canceled within the 3 weeks you will forfeit your deposit. · Your reservation is not eligible for a refund 1 week prior to your event. · Customers will receive a full refund with 72 hours notice of cancellation. · Customers will also receive a full refund in case of operator cancellation due to weather or other unforeseen circumstances. · Captain fee $50/hour, paid directly on arrival via Apple Pay, Venmo, PayPal, or cash · Bring your own beverages and food, no upcharge · Shelter Island dock, walk down walkway between Intrepid Boat Works and San Diego Marine Exchange to the water, meet
